body: On World Crisis PhaseEmergence, spawn nm-chaos-elemental-1/2/3 in zone 3. Killing them contributes ObjectiveIntercept and drops crisis-shard (new tradeable item). Crisis auto-resets after PhaseResolution broadcast.
title: S95-02: MUD crisis NM spawns — 3 Chaos Elementals in Swamp on PhaseEmergence, drop crisis-shard
